message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023**.  
(“Observed” dates are the statutory holiday dates when the actual holiday falls on a weekend.)

| Holiday | 2023 Date | Observed (if applicable) | Long‑Weekend Dates (inclusive) |
|---------|-----------|--------------------------|--------------------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sun) | Jan 2 (Mon) | Jan 1 – 3 |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, etc.) | Feb 20 (Mon) | – | Feb 18 – 20 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Fri) | – | Apr 7 – 9 |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Mon) | – | May 20 – 22 |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Sat) | Jul 3 (Mon) | Jul 1 – 3 |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Mon) | – | Sep 2 – 4 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Mon) | – | Oct 7 – 9 |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Sat) | Nov 13 (Mon) | Nov 11 – 13 |
| Christmas | Dec 25 (Mon) | – | Dec 23 – 25 |

> **Notes**  
> * Some provinces have additional holidays that create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. George’s Day in British Columbia).  
> * The table above lists the nationwide statutory holidays that generate long weekends in 2023.  
> * If you need province‑specific long weekends, let me know and I can provide those as well.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app or convert it to JSON/CSV if that’s more convenient. Let me know if you’d like the data in a different format!
